title: Design-conformance findings
description: The canon behind a Design-Conformance report. The published page is a PROJECTION of this file — fix a claim here and rebuild, never hand-edit the generated HTML. Prose fields accept inline HTML and are rendered, not escaped. NOTE: the kit validator implements a deliberately small keyword set (no $ref / oneOf / if-then), so two rules that cannot be expressed here are enforced by dc-report.mjs at build time instead, and it fails closed on both: a finding carrying `impact` must also carry `severitySource`, and every clip file named must exist.

title.description: Browser-tab / gallery name for the page.

meta.description: Identity of both sides. A round that does not record WHICH design export it judged cannot be re-checked later.

findings.description: One entry per oracle conflict. Both sides are stated and the report does not pick the winner.

story.description: The requirement this is judged against, as the spec names it.

impact.description: Chip text. Impact is a judgement someone owns, never a fact about the product.

severitySource.description: REQUIRED whenever impact is set — dc-report.mjs refuses to build without it. Stays 'agent-proposed' until the owner has actually rated it; an unattributed rating reads as the owner's own call by the second meeting.

requires.description: What the spec requires, QUOTED — one entry per quoted criterion. Paraphrase is where the reviewer's opinion leaks in, and the quote is what the owner will argue about.

observed.description: What the design does, as observed while DRIVING it — not as read off its markup.

clips.description: Evidence. Any claim about a flow — skipped, blocked, refused, reachable — needs one.

file.description: Filename inside the evidence dir; the builder refuses to build if it is missing.

poster.description: Frame showing the state that PROVES the finding — not wherever the clip happens to end.

decision.description: Who decides and what the options are. The report proposes; it does not rule.

coverage.description: Rows of the coverage table. 'Declared but unreachable' is reported as NOT VERIFIED, never as covered.
